lines.name: Line 2A: Cat Linh – Ha Dong
lines.description: Hanoi's first metro line (elevated, 13 km, 12 stations), opened 6 Nov 2021. The 100-year master plan extends it south-west along Highway 6 to Xuân Mai (~20 km, construction targeted 2026–Dec 2030) and north-east from Cát Linh via Hanoi Station, Gia Lâm and Cổ Loa to Yên Thường (~21 km, 2031–2035). Extension alignments are indicative. Color as used by OpenStreetMap/Wikipedia (green).

Extension Cát Linh – Gia Lâm – Cổ Loa – Yên Thường (~21 km)

lines.name: Line 3: Nhon – Hanoi Station
lines.description: Elevated section Nhổn – Cầu Giấy (8.5 km, 8 stations) opened 8 Aug 2024. The 4 km underground section Cầu Giấy – Hanoi Station (4 stations) finished tunnel boring in Apr 2026 and is scheduled for commercial operation at the end of 2027. Planned extensions: Hanoi Station – Hoàng Mai/Yên Sở (8.8 km underground, 7 stations, in project preparation with EU/AFD support; listed for 2026–2030), Nhổn – Trôi – Sơn Tây (30.7 km, 2026–2030 list) and Yên Sở – Ngọc Hồi (6 km, 2031–2035). Line color (olive green) is the one used on station signage per Wikipedia/OSM.

lines.nameLocal: Tuyến 1: Nội Bài – Yên Viên – Ga Hà Nội – Ngọc Hồi
lines.description: North–south trunk line from Nội Bài airport via Yên Viên, Gia Lâm and Hanoi Station to Ngọc Hồi and the Hùng Vương (Trống Đồng) stadium area. Groundbreaking 22 Jun 2026 (Vinhomes–SGC EPC/turnkey contract signed Oct 2026), target 2030; ~60 km in the 2026–2030 list (81 km in other reports). Further branches to the second airport, Đại Nghĩa, Sóc Sơn and Phúc Yên are in the 2036–2045 phase. Stations and alignment are provisional (OpenStreetMap tracing of published plan maps). Color from the vi.wikipedia planning-map palette.

The Nội Bài – Nam Thăng Long, Trần Hưng Đạo – Thượng Đình and Thượng Đình – Hùng Vương Stadium sections broke ground 22 Jun 2026 under the Vinhomes–SGC turnkey contract (target 2030); an extension to Phú Xuyên is in the 2036–2045 phase. Outer-section stations are placeholders; Trần Hưng Đạo – Thượng Đình uses station names from the earlier approved design. Color chosen (planning maps reuse 2A green).

lines.name: Line 5: Van Cao – Hoa Lac
lines.description: 39.6 km, 20 stations (6 underground under Văn Cao – Liễu Giai – Nguyễn Chí Thanh – Trần Duy Hưng, then elevated/at-grade along Thăng Long Avenue to Thạch Bình). Alignment approved by Decision 4602/QĐ-UBND (4 Sep 2025); construction started 19 Dec 2025, target 2030. Extension Văn Cao – Cổ Loa – Dương Xá – Cổ Bi (~27 km) is in the 2031–2035 phase; a further extension to Hòa Lạc airport / the Ethnic Culture Village is only mentioned as possible. Station positions are estimated along the OSM-traced alignment. Color from the vi.wikipedia planning-map palette.

notes: Network per the Capital Master Plan with a 100-year vision (Decision 2512/QĐ-UBND, 13 May 2026): 18 urban rail lines, about 979 km, building on Resolution 188/2025/QH15 and the 2024 general plan (Decision 1668/QĐ-TTg, 14-15 lines, about 617 km). Years are official phase targets: 2030 for the 2026–2030 list, 2035 for 2031–2035 and 2045 for 2036–2045; branches without a stated phase appear only at the end of the timeline. Lines 1, 2 (outer sections), 8, 10 and 14 broke ground on 22 Jun 2026 under a Vinhomes–SGC turnkey contract; their station names and positions are provisional (traced in OpenStreetMap from published plan maps) and may change. Planned-line stations are indicative waypoints placed at the named places, not designed stations; all estimated locations are flagged approx. Paths are drawn only where OpenStreetMap has an alignment; elsewhere stations are joined by straight lines. Only lines 2A and 3 have official line colors on signage; other colors follow the vi.wikipedia planning-map palette or were chosen for contrast. No monorail, LRT or tram lines appear in the 2026 plan (the 2016 plan had three monorail lines).
